obj.cause: The upper bound allows n == len(s), but the last valid string index is len(s) - 1, so s[n] raises IndexError at the end boundary.
obj.change: Use a strict upper bound for the length check so only indexes less than len(s) are accepted.
obj.verification: The failing case nth_char('ab', 2) will skip indexing and return ''. Also check nth_char('ab', 1) still returns 'b'.
